newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper loses slightly, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper loses slightly, other metals steady.

text.p: Copper lost marginally on Monday on stray selling while other base metals were steady in dull trade, dealers said.
Copper lost 25 rupees to 30,425 rupees on poor demand.
"The market is dull. There is no pressure of buying or selling," said Bombay Metals Exchange president Sharad Parikh.

Zinc was steady at 7,850 rupees per quintal. Aluminium was quiet at 7,450 rupees per quintal. Lead was offered at 4,550 rupees pwer quintal and tin was unchanged at 31,000 rupees per quintal. Nickel was unchanged at 35,800 rupees per quintal.
